name: spanning tree plus odd-degree matching, then shortcut
mechanism: build a minimum spanning tree, add a minimum perfect matching on its odd-degree vertices to make every degree even, walk the resulting closed trail, and skip repeated vertices to get a tour within a factor of the optimum

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Christofides algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs:
